Report: the tags shown in dashboard settings, the time range shown in the top bar, and whether the save succeeded.

provenance.instruction: On the Grafana dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfwoeaxjxu1hca/fwgr11-n1-bench-dashboard, do two things and then save: (1) Open dashboard settings (gear icon), go to the General settings section, and add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard's Tags field (type 'bench' and press Enter to add it as a tag chip). (2) Set the dashboard time range to 'Last 6 hours' using the time range picker in the top bar (select 'Last 6 hours' from the quick ranges). Then SAVE the dashboard (Ctrl+S or Save dashboard button) and confirm the save succeeded. Report: the tags shown in dashboard settings, the time range shown in the top bar, and whether the save succeeded.
